name: ihris-use-cases
title: iHRIS use-case model (2009)
description: The use cases, actors and requirements of iHRIS Common, Manage, Qualify and Plan, from four Serlio CaseComplete reports (2009, document author sturlington), parsed into structured records and Markdown, with a crosswalk from each use case to the iHRIS 4.3.3 forms it names.

source.status: four .doc reports uploaded into the building session by the owner, 2026-09-23; no public copy is known

licence.grantedBy: the folio owner (litlfred), asked in the building session
licence.basis: The reports state no licence. Asked whether the full text may be published, the owner answered 'I have permission'.
licence.scope: Publish the full text of the four reports (use cases with their steps, extensions and notes; actors; requirements) on this folio and its site, attributed.
excludes: the 'Assigned To' field (staff initials, 12 use cases in Manage): the initials are not published; each person is referenced by an opaque actor (scenarios/actors/ihris-2009-staff-NN.json), identity withheld

a requirement's 'Source' field (a named person, 12 requirements in Qualify): the name is not published; each person is referenced by an opaque actor (scenarios/actors/ihris-2009-staff-NN.json), identity withheld

who each opaque actor stands for: owner, 2026-09-23, one opaque Actor per distinct person, and the mapping from a person to their actor lives in the data store only, never in this repository (bean ihris-actr, folio-assistant issue #1180)
licence.attribution: From the iHRIS use-case model by IntraHealth International / the Capacity Project iHRIS team (2009), published with permission.

assets.title: iHRIS use-case model (2009)
assets.description: What was parsed, the crosswalk method, and what is cited but not described.

directories.description: <product>.json (ihris-use-cases/v1) and <product>.md for common, manage, qualify and plan; roles.md (the roles and opaque actors, for reading); crosswalk.json (ihris-use-case-crosswalk/v1); manifest.jsonld. scenarios/ is declared on its own, below.

directories.readOnlyBasis: Generated by src/tools/ingest_use_cases.py from the verified .doc files in uploads/ihris-use-cases/.
directories.description: The actors the 2009 reports describe, as Roles in the iHRIS domain (roles.json, folio-assistant's RoleGraphSchema: one per A-id, title and description verbatim), and the people the reports name in 'Assigned To' or a requirement's 'Source', as opaque actors (actors/ihris-2009-staff-NN.json, folio-assistant's ActorDef, identity withheld).
